versions.headline: Real Madrid 主場大熱，預計輕取 PSV
reasons: Real Madrid 歐冠四戰全勝，Mbappé、Vinícius 都能上陣
PSV 進攻效率差（場均0.8球），主力 M. Júnior 缺陣
賠率持續向主隊收緊，市場信心很強
versions.headline_en: Real Madrid heavy favourites to beat PSV comfortably
reasons_en: Real Madrid are 4/4 in the UCL with Mbappé and Vinícius available
PSV's finishing is poor (0.8 goals per game) and starter M. Júnior is out
The home odds keep shortening, showing strong market confidence

versions.headline: Man City 主場應可擊敗傷兵滿營的 Napoli
reasons: Napoli 缺了 Marín（停賽）、Meret、Lobotka 等多名球員，中場和門將位置都受影響
Man City 控球壓制力強，角球預計大幅領先
City 聯賽近況一般，週末又要對 Arsenal，可能留力
versions.headline_en: Man City should beat an injury-ravaged Napoli at home
reasons_en: Napoli are missing Marín (suspended), Meret, Lobotka and others, which hits both midfield and goalkeeper
City's possession dominance should give them a big lead in corners
City's league form is so-so and Arsenal come next at the weekend, so they may hold something back

versions.headline: Inter 主場較佔優，大雨可能影響進球
reasons: Inter 實力較強，但中場核心 Çalhanoğlu 缺陣，Zieliński 也成疑
Stuttgart 歐冠防守不錯（場均失1球），犯規多
米蘭預計有大雨（15mm），進球數下調到低於市場預期
versions.headline_en: Inter favoured at home; heavy rain may limit goals
reasons_en: Inter are stronger, but midfield anchor Çalhanoğlu is out and Zieliński is doubtful
Stuttgart defend well in the UCL (1 conceded per game) and foul a lot
Heavy rain (15mm) is forecast in Milan, so expected goals are set below the market

versions.headline: Inter 主場佔優，但中場缺兵，Stuttgart 有能力纏鬥
reasons: Inter 實力較強，但中場 Çalhanoğlu 和 Zieliński 都確定缺陣
Stuttgart 歐冠防守不錯（場均失1球），犯規多
雨量預報由15mm降到2.7mm，天氣影響減少，進球預期略為回升
versions.key_changes: Zieliński 從成疑變為確定缺陣，Inter 勝率由64%降至63%；雨量預報大減，大2.5球和預期進球稍微上調。
versions.headline_en: Inter favoured at home, but a depleted midfield lets Stuttgart compete
reasons_en: Inter are stronger, but both Çalhanoğlu and Zieliński are now confirmed out
Stuttgart defend well in the UCL (1 conceded per game) and foul a lot
The rain forecast dropped from 15mm to 2.7mm, so weather matters less and the goal expectation rises slightly
versions.key_changes_en: Zieliński went from doubtful to out, so Inter's win drops from 64% to 63%; the much lighter rain forecast nudges over 2.5 and expected goals up.

versions.headline: Atlético Madrid 主場應能擊敗 Viking
reasons: Atlético Madrid 實力明顯較強，Viking 作客防守差（場均失3球）
Atlético 歐冠進攻一般，加上3天後又有聯賽，可能輪換，比分未必很大
Viking 有反擊能力，但作客 xG 偏低
versions.headline_en: Atlético Madrid should beat Viking at home
reasons_en: Atlético are clearly stronger, and Viking's away defence is poor (3 conceded per game)
Atlético's UCL attack has been ordinary, and a league game 3 days later may bring rotation, so the margin may not be huge
Viking can counter-attack, but their away xG is low

versions.headline: Atlético Madrid 派出主力陣容，主場應能穩勝 Viking
reasons: 首發有 J. Álvarez、Sørloth、Koke、K. Lee，沒有因週末聯賽而大幅輪換
Viking 本季歐冠作客兩戰全負，場均失3球，作客 xG 只有0.69
Atlético 歐冠進攻效率一般，加上之前總進球常被高估，比分預計不會太大
缺陣的 Lookman、Romero 都是輪換球員，影響有限
versions.key_changes: 首發確認是主力陣容，沒有輪換，主勝由82%略升至84%，客勝降至5%。
versions.headline_en: Atlético Madrid field a full-strength XI and should beat Viking at home
reasons_en: XI includes J. Álvarez, Sørloth, Koke and K. Lee, with no heavy rotation for the weekend league game
Viking have lost both UCL away games, conceding 3 per game with only 0.69 away xG
Atlético's UCL attack has been modest and total goals have been overestimated before, so no huge scoreline expected
Absentees Lookman and Romero are rotation players, so limited impact
versions.key_changes_en: Confirmed full-strength XI with no rotation: home win nudged from 82% to 84%, away win down to 5%.

versions.headline: PSG 主場佔優，但缺 Doué 後 Roma 仍有機會進球
reasons: PSG 歐冠四戰全勝，進20球，但最佳球員 Doué 和 Kvaratskhelia 缺陣
Roma 國內進攻火熱（連續大勝），有能力進球
Roma 犯規多（場均14.5次），客隊黃牌預計較多
versions.headline_en: PSG favoured at home, but Roma can score with Doué absent
reasons_en: PSG are 4/4 with 20 goals, but star man Doué and Kvaratskhelia are out
Roma's attack is on fire domestically (a string of big wins) and can score
Roma foul a lot (14.5 per game), so expect more away bookings

versions.headline: PSG 仍是熱門，但前場陣容偏年輕，Roma 有能力進球
reasons: Doué、Kvaratskhelia 缺陣，前場由 Mayulu、F. Torres、Akliouche 擔任，火力不如前幾場
賠率由開盤1.36退到1.53，市場明顯下調 PSG 優勢
Roma 國內進攻火熱，Soulé、Castro 正選，有能力進球
Roma 犯規多（場均14.5次），客隊黃牌預計較多
versions.key_changes: 首發確認 PSG 前場偏年輕，加上主勝賠率持續退，主勝由64%降至60%，客勝升至19%。
versions.headline_en: PSG still favourites, but a young front line gives Roma a chance to score
reasons_en: With Doué and Kvaratskhelia out, Mayulu, F. Torres and Akliouche lead the line, which is less potent than in earlier games
Odds drifted from 1.36 to 1.53, so the market has clearly cut PSG's edge
Roma's attack is in fine domestic form, with Soulé and Castro starting
Roma foul a lot (14.5 per game), so the away side should collect more cards
versions.key_changes_en: Confirmed young PSG front line plus a steadily drifting home price: home win cut from 64% to 60%, away win up to 19%.

versions.headline: Arsenal 防守穩固，預計零封 Dortmund 取勝
reasons: Arsenal 本季歐冠場均只失0.8球，主場很少給對手機會
缺陣的 Saka、Raya、Zubimendi 削弱了陣容深度，主客差距比市場開盤時小
Dortmund 上半場進攻普遍慢熱，上半場以平局機會最大
週末對 Man City，Arsenal 可能有少量輪換
versions.headline_en: Solid Arsenal tipped to beat Dortmund without conceding
reasons_en: Arsenal concede only 0.8 per UCL game and give little away at home
Missing Saka, Raya and Zubimendi thins the squad, so the gap is smaller than the opening odds suggested
Dortmund tend to start slowly, so a level first half is the most likely
With Man City at the weekend, Arsenal may rotate slightly

versions.headline: Liverpool 作客稍佔優，但 Club Brugge 有能力進球
reasons: Liverpool 進攻強（場均3.5球）但防守不穩，雙方都進球的可能性高
Club Brugge 本季歐冠進攻犀利，但主力 Virgili 缺陣
Liverpool 角球產量很高（場均9.2個），預計角球大幅領先
versions.headline_en: Liverpool slight away favourites, but Brugge can score
reasons_en: Liverpool attack well (3.5 per game) but are shaky at the back, so both teams scoring is likely
Brugge have been sharp in attack in the UCL, but starter Virgili is out
Liverpool win lots of corners (9.2 per game) and should lead clearly in that count

versions.headline: Liverpool 稍佔優，但 Club Brugge 主場陣容齊整，雙方都進球機會高
reasons: Liverpool 進攻強（場均3.5球）但防守不穩，雙方都進球的可能性高
Club Brugge 最新傷停名單上沒有人，陣容齊整，主場歐冠進攻犀利
Liverpool 缺 Gakpo、Ekitiké、Gravenberch，中前場深度受影響
Liverpool 角球產量很高（場均9.2個），預計角球大幅領先
versions.key_changes: 最新資料顯示 Club Brugge 沒有傷停（上一版以為 Virgili 缺陣），主勝由22%微升至24%，第三比分改為2-2。
versions.headline_en: Liverpool slight favourites, but a full-strength Club Brugge make both teams scoring likely
reasons_en: Liverpool score heavily (3.5 per game) but are leaky, so both teams scoring is likely
Club Brugge's latest list shows no absentees and they attack well at home in the UCL
Liverpool miss Gakpo, Ekitiké and Gravenberch, thinning their midfield and attack
Liverpool's corner output is very high (9.2 per game)
versions.key_changes_en: The latest data shows no Club Brugge absentees (the last version assumed Virgili was out), so the home win goes from 22% to 24% and the third score is now 2-2.

versions.headline: Man Utd 狀態差兼缺兵，Sporting 主場略佔優
reasons: Man Utd 近期聯賽0-4、0-2、0-3連敗，Cunha 停賽，Šeško、Baleba 受傷
Sporting 陣容齊整，主場 xG 高，但週末要打 Porto 德比
市場認為兩隊接近，我們稍微偏向主隊
versions.headline_en: Out-of-form, depleted Man Utd; Sporting slight home favourites
reasons_en: Man Utd have lost league games 0-4, 0-2 and 0-3 recently; Cunha is suspended and Šeško and Baleba are injured
Sporting have a full squad and a high home xG, though the Porto derby follows at the weekend
The market sees it as close; we lean slightly to the hosts

versions.headline: Sporting 主場稍佔優，但市場持續看好 Man Utd，兩隊接近，平局機會不小
reasons: Man Utd 缺 Cunha（停賽）、Šeško、Baleba、Rashford，近期聯賽表現很差
Sporting 陣容齊整，主場 xG 高，但週末要打 Porto，可能保留體力
賠率由開盤 2.55/2.55 變為 2.7/2.45，市場逐漸偏向客隊，所以拉近主客勝率
裁判 Marciniak 場均犯規24.5次，比賽可能較碎，黃牌偏多
versions.key_changes: 主勝由42%降到39%、客勝由32%升到35%：賠率持續向 Man Utd 傾斜，向市場靠攏；總進球微調下調，因為我們本季一直高估進球。
versions.headline_en: Sporting slight home edge, but the market keeps drifting toward Man Utd; close game with a real draw chance
reasons_en: Man Utd miss Cunha (suspended), Šeško, Baleba and Rashford, and their recent league form is poor
Sporting have a full squad and strong home xG, but face Porto at the weekend and may manage minutes
Odds moved from 2.55/2.55 at opening to 2.7/2.45, the market leaning to the away side, so home/away gap narrowed
Referee Marciniak averages 24.5 fouls per game, so expect a stop-start match with plenty of cards
versions.key_changes_en: Home win 42%→39%, away win 32%→35%: moved toward the market as odds keep drifting to Man Utd; total goals trimmed slightly because we have been overestimating goals this season.

versions.headline: 中立場地勢均力敵，平局可能性高
reasons: Shakhtar 在中立場地主場作賽，主場優勢有限，主力 K. Elias 缺陣
Shakhtar 進失球都少（場均各1球），比賽節奏偏慢
Fenerbahçe 防守不穩但有 Lukaku、Greenwood，雙方實力接近
versions.headline_en: Evenly matched at a neutral venue; a draw is quite likely
reasons_en: Shakhtar's 'home' game is at a neutral venue, so home advantage is limited, and starter K. Elias is out
Shakhtar score and concede little (1 each per game), pointing to a slow tempo
Fenerbahçe are shaky at the back but have Lukaku and Greenwood; the sides are close in strength

versions.headline: Bodø/Glimt 主場優勢明顯，預計小勝 LASK
reasons: Bodø/Glimt 在零下近5°C的人造草皮主場很難對付，本季歐冠主場未失球
LASK 防守漏洞大，場均失2.2球，主力後衛 A. Andrade 缺陣
LASK 進攻有一定威脅，雙方都進球的可能性不低
裁判 Meler 出牌偏多，LASK 犯規多，客隊黃牌預計較多
versions.headline_en: Bodø/Glimt's home edge should see off LASK narrowly
reasons_en: Bodø/Glimt are tough at home on artificial turf at around -5°C and haven't conceded at home in the UCL this season
LASK's defence is leaky (2.2 conceded per game) and starting defender A. Andrade is out
LASK carry some attacking threat, so both teams scoring is quite likely
Referee Meler shows plenty of cards and LASK foul a lot, so expect more away bookings

versions.headline: Leipzig 國內狀態火熱，主場應能擊敗 Lens
reasons: Leipzig 最近聯賽5-1、5-2大勝，狀態比歐冠成績好得多
Lens 歐冠場均失4球，主力 Cuisance、Aguilar 缺陣
Lens 角球產量不低，角球數不會一面倒
versions.headline_en: In-form Leipzig should beat Lens at home
reasons_en: Leipzig won 5-1 and 5-2 in recent league games, far better than their UCL results suggest
Lens concede 4 per UCL game and starters Cuisance and Aguilar are out
Lens win plenty of corners, so the corner count shouldn't be one-sided

versions.headline: Feyenoord 狀態低迷，Porto 稍佔優
reasons: Feyenoord 近期聯賽連續不勝，主力 Hadj Moussa 缺陣
Porto 國內近況穩定，陣容齊整
Porto 週末要打 Sporting 德比，可能輪換；天氣寒冷有風，進球數不會太高
versions.headline_en: Out-of-form Feyenoord; Porto have a slight edge
reasons_en: Feyenoord are winless in recent league games and starter Hadj Moussa is out
Porto are in steady domestic form with a near-full squad
Porto face the Sporting derby at the weekend and may rotate; cold, windy weather points to a modest goal count

versions.headline: Porto 陣容齊整略佔優，但 Hadj Moussa 復出首發，Feyenoord 主場仍有機會拿分
reasons: Hadj Moussa 列入 Feyenoord 正式首發，上一版以為他缺陣，主隊進攻比預期好一點
Porto 派出 Giménez、Pepê 等主力，沒有因週末對 Sporting 而大輪換
賽前賠率持續向 Porto 傾斜（客勝 2.25→2.05），市場信心增加
氣溫接近 0°C 且風較大，進球數預計不會太高
versions.key_changes: 修正上一版的錯誤：Hadj Moussa 其實首發；但 Porto 也派出主力，賠率繼續看好客隊，兩者大致抵消，客勝由 43% 微升至 44%，主勝 30%→29%。
versions.headline_en: Porto, at full strength, are slight favourites, but with Hadj Moussa back in the XI Feyenoord can still take something at home
reasons_en: Hadj Moussa is in Feyenoord's confirmed XI; the last version wrongly had him out, so the home attack is a bit better than assumed
Porto start Giménez, Pepê and other regulars, with no heavy rotation before the weekend's Sporting derby
Pre-match odds kept moving toward Porto (away 2.25→2.05), showing growing market confidence
Near-freezing temperature and fairly strong wind should keep goals in check
versions.key_changes_en: Corrected the last version's error: Hadj Moussa does start. But Porto also field their regulars and the odds keep favouring them, so the two roughly cancel out: away win up slightly from 43% to 44%, home win from 30% to 29%.

versions.headline: Galatasaray 傷兵多，Aston Villa 稍佔上風
reasons: Galatasaray 缺了 Osimhen、Sallai、Leão，Jakobs 也成疑，進攻火力明顯下降
Aston Villa 歐冠進攻效率高，但近期聯賽狀態一般（連續兩場平局）
伊斯坦堡主場氣氛熱烈，平局機會不小
市場賠率持續偏向 Aston Villa
versions.headline_en: Injury-hit Galatasaray; Aston Villa slight favourites
reasons_en: Galatasaray are without Osimhen, Sallai and Leão, with Jakobs doubtful, so their attack is much weaker
Villa have been efficient going forward in the UCL, but their league form is patchy (two draws in a row)
The Istanbul atmosphere keeps a draw very much in play
The odds have kept moving towards Aston Villa

versions.headline: 首發確認 Galatasaray 前場沒有 Osimhen 等主力，市場持續看好 Aston Villa，客隊小幅佔優
reasons: Galatasaray 缺陣主力是 Osimhen 和 Sallai，鋒線由 Barış Alper Yılmaz、Akgün、Batrakov 頂上，正印中鋒不在，進攻質量下降
Aston Villa 原本成疑的 Lindelöf 正常首發，後防完整；本季歐冠客隊進攻效率高（xG 場均 2.4）
Aston Villa 客勝賠率由開盤 2.35 降到 1.95，去除抽水後客勝約 48%，市場明顯傾向客隊
伊斯坦堡主場氣氛熱烈，加上 Siebert 執法場均黃牌 3.5 張，平局和黃牌都不能低估
versions.key_changes: 客勝由 43% 上調到 46%，主勝由 32% 下調到 29%：首發確認 Galatasaray 前場沒有正印中鋒、Aston Villa 的 Lindelöf 正常出戰，而且臨場客勝賠率再降到 1.95。最可能比分改為 1-2，黃牌稍微上調。
versions.headline_en: Confirmed XIs show Galatasaray without Osimhen and other key forwards; the market keeps backing Aston Villa, who are slight favourites
reasons_en: Galatasaray are missing key starters Osimhen and Sallai; Barış Alper Yılmaz, Akgün and Batrakov lead the line with no recognised No.9, so attacking quality drops
Aston Villa's doubtful Lindelöf starts, so their back line is intact; Villa have been very productive in the UCL this season (2.4 xG per game)
Villa's odds shortened from 2.35 at opening to 1.95; after removing the bookmaker margin that is about 48% for an away win
The Istanbul atmosphere and referee Siebert (3.5 yellows per game) keep the draw and the card count live
versions.key_changes_en: Away win raised from 43% to 46%, home win cut from 32% to 29%: the confirmed XI has no recognised striker for Galatasaray, Lindelöf starts for Villa, and the late away price shortened again to 1.95. Most likely score is now 1-2; cards nudged up.

versions.headline: Bayern 大批主力缺陣，作客 Lille 不再是大熱門
reasons: Kane、Neuer、Davies 缺陣，Olise 成疑，賠率從1.33大幅退到1.62
Lille 歐冠只得1分，但主場仍有進球能力
Bayern 2.8天後又有聯賽，陣容深度受考驗，平局機會上升
versions.headline_en: Depleted Bayern no longer big favourites at Lille
reasons_en: Kane, Neuer and Davies are out and Olise is doubtful; the odds drifted from 1.33 to 1.62
Lille have only 1 UCL point but can still score at home
Bayern play again in 2.8 days, testing their depth and raising the draw chance

versions.headline: Bayern 傷兵滿營，仍稍佔優，但平局機會不低
reasons: Kane、Neuer、Davies 缺陣，Olise 由成疑變為確定缺陣，前場創造力大減
賠率從1.33大幅退到1.62，市場已反映陣容問題
Lille 歐冠只得1分，但主場仍有進球能力
Bayern 2.8天後又有聯賽，陣容深度受考驗
versions.key_changes: Olise 確定缺陣（上一版是成疑），客勝由55%降至53%，Bayern 預期進球稍微下調；模型無法量化單一球員的影響，只做小幅調整。
versions.headline_en: Injury-hit Bayern still slight favourites, but a draw is quite possible
reasons_en: Kane, Neuer and Davies are out, and Olise has gone from doubtful to out, cutting creativity sharply
Odds drifted from 1.33 to 1.62, so the market has priced in the squad problems
Lille have only 1 UCL point but can still score at home
Bayern play a league game 2.8 days later, testing their depth
versions.key_changes_en: Olise is now confirmed out (was doubtful), so the away win drops from 55% to 53% and Bayern's expected goals dip slightly; the model can't quantify one player's impact, so the adjustment is small.

versions.headline: 兩隊都急需積分，Villarreal 稍被看好
reasons: Villarreal 歐冠防守差，但國內實力和個人能力更強
Slavia Praha 國內近況很好，主場有一定競爭力
雙方都在出局線附近，比賽可能較開放，雙方都進球機會高
versions.headline_en: Both need points; Villarreal slightly favoured
reasons_en: Villarreal's UCL defence has been poor, but they have more domestic quality and individual talent
Slavia Praha are in fine domestic form and competitive at home
Both sit near the elimination line, so an open game with both teams scoring is likely

versions.headline: Barcelona 實力差距大，即使沒有 Yamal 也應大勝 Sabah
reasons: 兩隊實力相差懸殊，Barcelona 控球和射門都會一面倒
Yamal 缺陣會降低 Barcelona 的創造力，但 Raphinha、Pedri 仍在
巴庫陣風近50km/h，可能令進球數略少於市場預期
versions.headline_en: Barcelona should cruise past Sabah even without Yamal
reasons_en: There is a huge quality gap; Barcelona should dominate possession and shots
Yamal's absence reduces Barcelona's creativity, but Raphinha and Pedri are available
Gusts near 50 km/h in Baku may keep goals slightly below market expectations

versions.headline: Barcelona 首發接近主力，大勝 Sabah 的機會很高
reasons: Barcelona 由 Pedri、Gavi、de Jong 坐鎮中場，Yamal 缺陣，但整體實力仍然差距懸殊
客勝賠率從 1.08 降到 1.06，市場更加看好 Barcelona
Sabah 缺主力 McCarthy，本季歐冠場均被射正和角球都很多
巴庫陣風接近 47km/h，而且模型平時高估進球，所以總進球比市場略低
versions.key_changes: 首發確認 Barcelona 中場主力全部上陣、客勝賠率繼續下降，客勝由 85% 提高到 87%；Raphinha 不在首發，進攻火力略降
versions.headline_en: Near-strongest Barcelona XI; a comfortable away win over Sabah is very likely

Away odds shortened from 1.08 to 1.06
Sabah miss key man McCarthy and have conceded many shots and corners in the UCL
Gusts near 47 km/h in Baku plus our goal over-estimation bias → total goals slightly below market

AEK 作客全敗，主力 Koita 停賽，防守壓力大
Como 缺 Diao 和 Kean，加上小雨，進球數略低於統計基準

reasons_en: Como's UCL attack has been prolific (4.8 goals per game) and they've won both home games
AEK have lost every away game and starter Koita is suspended
With Diao and Kean out and light rain forecast, goals are trimmed slightly below the baseline

Slovan 主力 Mustafić、Camara 缺陣，防線更弱
Real Betis 只缺 Ceballos，角球和控球應明顯佔優
versions.headline_en: Real Betis should win easily at bottom side Slovan
reasons_en: Slovan have lost all four, scoring 1 and conceding 17, with very low xG
Slovan starters Mustafić and Camara are out, further weakening the defence
Betis are missing only Ceballos and should dominate corners and possession

16938769.verdict: 主勝猜對，但過程波折：半場 0-1 落後，下半場 Real Madrid 連進 5 球，最後 5-1。
points: 上半場 PSV 靠點球領先，xG 一度壓過 Real Madrid，所以半場檢討誤判為大冷門，把主勝降到 17%。
下半場 Real Madrid xG 暴增，全場 4.79，Mbappé 進 2 球，個人能力扭轉局面，賽前看好主隊的方向是對的。
角球只有 4 比 1（上半場 0 比 0），遠低於預測的 6.3 比 3.7；黃牌 Real Madrid 3 張，多於預測的 1.2。
PSV 全場只有 1 次射正（即點球），進攻能力確實很差。
16938769.lesson: 半場檢討時不要過度反應：攻擊球員明顯更強的球隊落後時，下半場反撲的機會很大，勝率不應大幅下調。
16938769.verdict_en: Home win correct, but eventful: 0-1 down at half-time, then Real Madrid scored five after the break to win 5-1.
points_en: PSV led through a penalty and briefly topped the xG count, so the half-time update over-reacted, cutting the home win to 17%.
Madrid's xG exploded after the break to 4.79; Mbappé scored twice, and star quality turned the game, so the pre-match call was right.
Corners were just 4–1 (0–0 in the 1st half) vs 6.3–3.7 predicted, and Madrid got 3 yellows vs 1.2 predicted.
PSV managed only 1 shot on target (the penalty), confirming their weak attack.
16938769.lesson_en: Don't over-react at half-time: a side with clearly superior attackers that trails still has a strong comeback chance, so don't slash its win probability.

16938774.verdict: 主勝預測失準，打成 2-2 平局；Man City 控球壓制，但進攻威脅不足，防守也被 Napoli 打穿兩次。
points: Napoli 雖然缺了 Lobotka、Meret 等多人，仍然靠快速反擊進了 2 球（xG 只有 0.61），效率極高。
City 角球 9 比 3 和預測的大幅領先一致，但上半場 xG 只有約 0.3，壓制沒有變成機會。
黃牌只有 1 張（預測 3.6），Napoli 犯規也比預測少，比賽很乾淨。
City 週末要對 Arsenal，可能有留力或輪換，終結和防守的專注度都不夠。
16938774.lesson: 強隊聯賽近況一般、又面臨週末大戰時，72% 的主勝太高，要多給平局概率。
16938774.verdict_en: Home win call failed: 2-2. City dominated the ball but lacked threat and were cut open twice by Napoli.
points_en: Depleted Napoli (no Lobotka, Meret) still scored twice on the break from just 0.61 xG, extremely clinical.
City's 9–3 corner edge matched the forecast, but their 1st-half xG was only about 0.3, so the dominance produced few chances.
Only 1 yellow vs 3.6 predicted; Napoli fouled far less than expected in a clean game.
With Arsenal at the weekend, City may have held back, and both finishing and defending lacked focus.
16938774.lesson_en: For a favourite in poor league form with a big weekend match coming, 72% home win is too high; give the draw more weight.

16938806.verdict: 主勝方向錯了，打成 1-1 平局；Arsenal 第10分鐘就領先，比預測的半場 0-0 早得多，但最後沒能贏下。
points: Arsenal 射門 29 次、xG 2.2，卻只有 4 次射正，進攻效率太低，沒有擴大領先。
角球預測 5.6 比 3.6，實際 8 比 5，兩隊都低估了；Dortmund 上半場角球還多過 Arsenal。
黃牌預測合計約 3.4 張，實際 0 張，裁判尺度很寬鬆，Dortmund 犯規 13 次也沒吃牌。
缺了 Saka、Raya、Zubimendi，Arsenal 的終結能力和控場穩定性下降，這點在下半場被扳平時看得出來。
16938806.lesson: 強隊缺少主力攻擊手時，即使控球和射門佔優，主勝概率也要下調，同時把平局概率提高。
16938806.verdict_en: Wrong on the home win: 1-1. Arsenal scored on 10', much earlier than the predicted 0-0 at half-time, but could not see the game out.
points_en: Arsenal had 29 shots and 2.2 xG but only 4 on target, so they never added to the lead.
Corners were under-predicted for both sides (5.6–3.6 predicted vs 8–5 actual), and Dortmund even won more corners in the 1st half.
About 3.4 yellows were expected and there were none: a very lenient referee, with Dortmund's 13 fouls going unpunished.
Without Saka, Raya and Zubimendi, Arsenal lacked finishing and control, which showed when Dortmund equalised after the break.
16938806.lesson_en: When a favourite is missing key attackers, trim the home-win probability and raise the draw even if they dominate possession and shots.

16938933.verdict: 勝負方向正確（主勝 67%），但比分和進球數高估，Bodø/Glimt 控球和 xG 佔優，最後只靠 90 分鐘的烏龍球取勝。
points: 預測比分 2-1／2-0，實際 1-0，而且唯一進球是 Bogarde 的烏龍球；Bodø/Glimt 全場 xG 只有 1.23、射正 2 次，進攻效率遠低於預期。
LASK 進攻威脅被高估：全場 xG 0.26、射正 0 次，『雙方都進球』的判斷不成立，Bodø/Glimt 主場延續零失球。
犯規分布判斷正確（LASK 14 次，Bodø/Glimt 5 次），但裁判 Meler 全場只出 2 張黃牌，比預測的 3.4 張少；LASK 犯規多，卻沒有換來黃牌。
角球主隊 4 次、客隊 0 次，總數低於預測的 9.5 次；一邊倒的控球沒有轉化成大量角球。
16938933.lesson: When a cold artificial-pitch home side faces a deep-sitting visitor, possession dominance may not mean multiple goals; lower the total and consider 1-0 as the top scoreline.
16938933.verdict_en: Right direction (67% home win), but goals and scoreline were overestimated: Bodø/Glimt dominated possession and xG yet won only via a 90th-minute own goal.
points_en: Predicted 2-1/2-0, actual 1-0 decided by a Bogarde own goal; Bodø/Glimt managed just 1.23 xG and 2 shots on target, far less clinical than expected.
LASK's attacking threat was overrated: 0.26 xG and no shots on target, so the BTTS lean failed and Bodø/Glimt kept another home clean sheet.
Foul split was read correctly (LASK 14 vs 5), but referee Meler showed only 2 yellows vs ~3.4 predicted; LASK's many fouls did not turn into cards.
Corners went 4-0, below the 9.5 total predicted; one-sided possession did not produce many corners.

16938941.verdict: 主勝猜對，比分 3-1 在前三選擇內；開場 9 分鐘連進兩球，半場領先幅度超出預測。
points: Leipzig 聯賽的好狀態延續到歐冠，判斷正確。
角球 10 比 4，遠多於預測的 5 比 5；Lens 角球產量不低的判斷錯了，早早落後反而被壓制。
Lens 黃牌 4 張（預測 2.0），落後方追分時犯規增加。
Lens 下半場曾追回 1 球，但進球效率低，符合歐冠防守差的特點。
16938941.lesson: 一方明顯佔優時，角球要往強隊傾斜，不要因為對手平時角球多就預測平分。
16938941.verdict_en: Home win correct and 3-1 was among the top three scores; two goals in the first 9 minutes beat the predicted half-time margin.
points_en: Leipzig's strong league form carried into the UCL, as predicted.
Corners were 10–4 vs a predicted 5–5; the view that Lens would win plenty of corners was wrong once they fell behind early.
Lens got 4 yellows (2.0 predicted) while chasing the game.
Lens pulled one back in the 2nd half but stayed inefficient, in line with their poor UCL defending.
16938941.lesson_en: When one side clearly dominates, tilt the corner forecast toward the stronger side instead of splitting it evenly because the opponent usually wins corners.

16938972.verdict: 客勝猜對（0-1 是比分第二選擇），但靠的是第2分鐘烏龍球，場面其實是 Feyenoord 佔優。
points: 第2分鐘的烏龍球打亂了模型的節奏假設，Porto 之後退守。
Feyenoord 射門 21 次、射正 7 次，領先後的 Porto 被壓著打；角球 8 比 4，高於預測的 4.7 比 4.0。
Porto 黃牌 4 張（預測 2.2），守住領先時犯規和拖延時間都會增加。
寒冷有風的天氣下總進球數只有 1 球，符合低進球的預期。
16938972.lesson: 客隊早早領先後，要預期落後的主隊角球和射門大增、領先方黃牌增加。
16938972.verdict_en: Away win correct (0-1 was the second-pick score), but it came from a 2nd-minute own goal while Feyenoord had the better of play.
points_en: The 2' own goal changed the game script, and Porto sat deep afterwards.
Feyenoord had 21 shots (7 on target) and won corners 8–4, above the predicted 4.7–4.0.
Porto took 4 yellows (2.2 predicted) as they defended the lead and wasted time.
Cold, windy conditions and only 1 goal matched the low-scoring expectation.
16938972.lesson_en: Once the away side leads early, expect the trailing home side's corners and shots to climb and the leading side's cards to rise.

16938980.verdict: 預測失誤：跟隨市場看好 Aston Villa 客勝（46%），結果 Galatasaray 在 Osimhen 缺陣下 1-0 取勝；黃牌數基本命中。
points: 勝負判斷錯誤：Aston Villa 全場射正 0 次、xG 只有 0.6，本季歐冠客場的進攻效率完全沒有延續，比分首選 1-2 也偏離。
低進球比賽的判斷大致合理（xG 合計 1.13）；半場 0-0 命中，半場更新後平局升到 37%，方向比賽前版本更接近，但仍偏向客隊。
黃牌合計 6 張，比預測的 4.5 張多，Aston Villa 吃到 4 張；下半場 52–58 分鐘連續 4 張黃牌，顯示比賽氣氛升溫，裁判 Siebert 出牌偏多的判斷正確。
角球 5:1，與預測的 4.3:5.3 相反；Galatasaray 射門 9 次，雖然缺少正印中鋒，主場仍然主動施壓。
16938980.lesson: Don't simply follow heavy market money on the away side; at hostile grounds like Istanbul, keep home-win and draw probabilities meaningful even when the home side lacks its top striker.
16938980.verdict_en: Miss: followed the market toward an Aston Villa away win (46%), but Galatasaray won 1-0 even without Osimhen; the card count was roughly right.
points_en: Wrong result: Aston Villa had zero shots on target and 0.6 xG, their strong UCL away form did not carry over, and the 1-2 top scoreline was off.
The low-scoring read was broadly sound (combined xG 1.13); 0-0 at half-time was correct, and the HT update raised the draw to 37%, closer than the pre-match call but still leaning away.
Six yellows vs ~4.5 predicted, four of them for Aston Villa; four cards between 52' and 58' showed the game heating up, confirming the read that referee Siebert cards a lot.
Corners went 5-1, the opposite of the 4.3-5.3 forecast; Galatasaray took 9 shots and still pressed at home despite missing their main striker.

16939035.verdict: 主勝猜對，但比分只有 1-0，進球和角球都遠低於預測。
points: Como xG 2.02 卻只進 1 球，Kean 缺陣後終結能力明顯下降。
全場角球只有 2 比 1，遠低於預測的 5.2 比 3.6，比賽多在中場爭奪、犯規頻繁（32 次）。
黃牌 2 比 3 和預測接近；AEK 落後後在下半場吃了 3 張黃牌，符合落後方犯規增加的規律。
半場 0-0 沒有猜中，但半場檢討時下調了 Como 的勝率，方向是對的。
16939035.lesson: 小組賽進攻數據亮眼的球隊缺了主力中鋒時，要調低總進球數，不能只看場均進球。
16939035.verdict_en: Home win correct, but only 1-0; goals and corners were well below the forecast.
points_en: Como created 2.02 xG but scored once; without Kean their finishing dropped clearly.
Only 2–1 corners vs 5.2–3.6 predicted: a scrappy midfield game with 32 fouls.
Cards (2–3) were close to the forecast; AEK picked up 3 yellows in the 2nd half while chasing the game.
The predicted 1-0 half-time score missed (0-0), though the half-time update rightly lowered Como's win chance.
16939035.lesson_en: When a high-scoring side is missing its main striker, cut the total-goals estimate instead of trusting goals-per-game averages.

16939039.verdict: 預測準確：客勝、比分 0-2（第一選擇）、半場 0-1 全部猜中。
points: Slovan 防守弱、進攻差的判斷正確，xG 只有 0.55。
Real Betis 控球 68%，但角球只有 4 個，遠低於預測的 6.8；控球多卻少打邊路傳中。
黃牌 1 比 1，少於預測的 2.0 比 2.2；Slovan 犯規 12 次卻只吃 1 張黃牌。
C. Hernández 個人進 2 球，Real Betis 機會品質明顯較高。
16939039.lesson: 控球佔優的技術型球隊不一定角球多，預測角球時要看球隊的進攻方式。
16939039.verdict_en: Spot on: away win, 0-2 (top-pick score) and 0-1 at half-time all correct.
points_en: Slovan's weak defence and poor attack were read correctly (0.55 xG).
Betis had 68% possession but only 4 corners vs 6.8 predicted: lots of the ball, few wide crosses.
Cards were 1–1, below the predicted 2.0–2.2; Slovan's 12 fouls drew only one yellow.
C. Hernández scored both, and Betis clearly created the better chances.
16939039.lesson_en: Possession-heavy technical sides don't always win many corners; check how a team attacks before forecasting corners.

16938769.verdict: 這是一大冷門：PSV xG 1.47 比 0.26 壓制 Real Madrid，靠點球領先，預測完全失準。
points: 預測 Real Madrid 半場 1-0 領先，實際主隊射正 0 次、沒有大機會，PSV 有 4 次大機會，Perišić 第32分鐘點球破門
雙方角球都是 0，遠低於預測的 3.0 比 1.7
黃牌 2 比 1，Tchouaméni 和 Rüdiger 吃牌，明顯超過預測的主隊 0.3 張，比賽火藥味重
16938769.headline: Real Madrid 下半場必然全力壓上，PSV 反擊空間大；Tchouaméni、Rüdiger 有黃牌，防守動作要收斂。
16938769.changes: 從主勝 80% 改為客勝 56%；最可能比分由 3-0 改成 0-1；Real Madrid 黃牌從 1.2 大升到 3.0；兩隊角球都因上半場 0 角球而下調。
16938769.verdict_en: Big upset: PSV out-created Real Madrid 1.47-0.26 xG and lead from the penalty spot; the forecast missed completely.
points_en: Forecast had Madrid 1-0 up at HT; instead Madrid had no shots on target and no big chances, PSV had 4 big chances and Perišić scored a 32' penalty
Zero corners for either side, far below the 3.0 vs 1.7 forecast
Cards 2-1 with Tchouaméni and Rüdiger booked, well above the 0.3 home forecast; a heated game
16938769.headline_en: Real Madrid must throw everything forward, leaving PSV room to counter; booked Tchouaméni and Rüdiger must be careful.
16938769.changes_en: Swung from 80% home win to 56% away win; most likely score 3-0 → 0-1; Madrid cards 1.2 → 3.0; corners cut for both after a cornerless first half.

16938774.verdict: Man City 控球 66% 卻幾乎沒有威脅，xG 只有 0.3，上半場進攻遠不如預測。
points: 預測半場 1-0、上半場 City 進 1.05 球，實際 xG 只有 0.3，City 控球多但打不穿 Napoli 的低位防守，可能和週末對 Arsenal 有所保留有關
Napoli 雖然多人缺陣，防守組織完整，xG 0.25 也不低
角球 4 比 2 方向正確；犯規 4 比 5 和雙方 0 黃牌都低於預測，比賽節奏溫和
16938774.headline: 下半場 City 會加強衝擊，但進攻效率低，小比分甚至 0-0 都有可能。
16938774.changes: 主勝從 72% 降到 48%，平局升到 38%；最可能比分由 2-0 改成 1-0；大2.5球機會大跌到 12%；黃牌下調。
16938774.verdict_en: Man City had 66% possession but almost no threat (0.3 xG); far less attacking output than forecast.
points_en: Forecast was 1-0 HT with City scoring 1.05 first-half goals; actual xG just 0.3. City could not break Napoli's low block, perhaps holding back before Arsenal at the weekend
Despite absentees Napoli stayed well organised and produced 0.25 xG themselves
Corners 4-2 went the forecast way; fouls 4-5 and zero cards were below forecast in a calm game
16938774.headline_en: City will push harder after the break, but with low efficiency a narrow result or even 0-0 is realistic.
16938774.changes_en: Home win down from 72% to 48%, draw up to 38%; most likely score 2-0 → 1-0; over 2.5 falls to 12%; cards lowered.

16938806.verdict: Arsenal 上半場佔優，比分領先，比預測的半場 0-0 更好；角球和犯規的分布卻和預測相反。
points: Gyökeres 第10分鐘進球，打破了「上半場平局最可能」的判斷；Arsenal xG 0.99 比 0.46、射門 14 比 8，壓制明顯
Dortmund 上半場角球 4 個，比 Arsenal 的 3 個還多，賽前預測的上半場角球 2.7 比 1.6 錯了方向，反映 Dortmund 主要靠反擊和定位球
Dortmund 犯規 7 次，遠多於預測的 5.8 次，Arsenal 只有 2 次；雙方都沒有黃牌，比預測的少
16938806.headline: Dortmund 落後會壓上，Arsenal 有反擊空間，再進一球就基本鎖定勝局。
16938806.changes: 主勝從 62% 升到 68%，因為已經領先而且 xG 佔優；Dortmund 角球產量比預期高，全場角球改成 Dortmund 略多；Dortmund 犯規預估由 12.0 提高到 13.0。
16938806.verdict_en: Arsenal controlled the first half and lead, better than the predicted 0-0 HT; corners and fouls went the opposite way to the forecast.
points_en: Gyökeres scored on 10', breaking the 'first-half draw most likely' call; Arsenal led xG 0.99-0.46 and shots 14-8
Dortmund won 4 corners to Arsenal's 3, so the 2.7 vs 1.6 corner forecast was the wrong way round, showing Dortmund lived on counters and set pieces
Dortmund committed 7 fouls (forecast 5.8) to Arsenal's 2; no yellow cards at all, fewer than forecast
16938806.headline_en: Dortmund must push; Arsenal will find counter-attacking space, and a second goal would all but settle it.
16938806.changes_en: Home win up from 62% to 68% on the lead and xG edge; full-time corners now slightly favour Dortmund given their output; Dortmund fouls raised from 12.0 to 13.0.

16938933.verdict: Bodø/Glimt 上半場全面壓制，但進攻效率不高，0-0 沒有兌現賽前預測的半場 1-0。
points: 賽前預測半場 1-0、上半場進球 [1.0, 0.4]；實際 Bodø/Glimt 控球 68%、射門 4-0、xG 0.41-0，有壓制但製造的機會質量一般，LASK 一腳射門都沒有。
上半場角球只有 1-0，遠低於預測的 [2.6, 1.9]；LASK 收得很深，Bodø/Glimt 多在禁區前橫傳，很少打到底線。
犯規 4-4，和預測 [4.0, 5.2] 接近；雙方都沒有黃牌，裁判 Meler 上半場比預期寬鬆。
16938933.headline: 下半場 Bodø/Glimt 會繼續圍攻，關鍵是能不能攻破 LASK 的密集防守；LASK 的機會主要靠反擊。
16938933.changes: 主勝由 67% 降到 54%，平局由 18% 升到 32%：上半場沒有進球，剩下的時間不多，而且 LASK 進攻威脅幾乎是零，所以客隊進球預期下調。最可能比分由 2-1 改為 1-0；角球、黃牌也跟著上半場偏低的節奏下調。
16938933.verdict_en: Bodø/Glimt dominated the first half but lacked cutting edge; 0-0 instead of the predicted 1-0 at half-time.
points_en: Predicted HT 1-0 and 1H goals [1.0, 0.4]; actual 68% possession, shots 4-0, xG 0.41-0 – control without high-quality chances, LASK had no shot at all.
Corners only 1-0 versus predicted [2.6, 1.9]; LASK sat deep and Bodø/Glimt rarely reached the byline.
Fouls 4-4, close to the predicted [4.0, 5.2]; no cards yet, Meler more lenient than expected.
16938933.headline_en: Expect continued Bodø/Glimt pressure in the second half; the question is whether they can break LASK's low block, while LASK rely on counters.
16938933.changes_en: Home win cut from 67% to 54% and draw raised from 18% to 32%: no goal so far, less time left, and LASK's attack has been almost non-existent, so away goals are lowered. Most likely score changed from 2-1 to 1-0; corners and cards trimmed to match the low first-half tempo.

16938941.verdict: Leipzig 開場 9 分鐘連進兩球，上半場完全壓制，比預測的半場 1-0 更好。
points: Raum（6'）、Nusa（9'）早段進球，Leipzig 的進球表現超過預測的上半場 1.05 球，延續聯賽的好狀態
Lens 射門只有 2 次、射正 0 次，xG 0.18，預測「角球不會一面倒」也錯了（3 比 1）
Lens 犯規 8 次，兩張黃牌（Ganiou、Sotoca），被壓得只能犯規阻止
16938941.headline: Leipzig 大局已定，下半場可能放慢節奏；Lens 壓上後角球會增加，但進攻威脅有限。
16938941.changes: 主勝從 70% 升到 95.5%；最可能比分改為 2-0；Lens 犯規（10.0 → 14.5）和黃牌（2.0 → 3.2）大幅上調；Leipzig 犯規下調。
16938941.verdict_en: Leipzig scored twice in 9 minutes and dominated, better than the predicted 1-0 HT.
points_en: Early goals from Raum (6') and Nusa (9') beat the 1.05 first-half goals forecast, continuing their league form
Lens had only 2 shots, none on target, 0.18 xG; the 'corners won't be one-sided' call was wrong too (3-1)
Lens committed 8 fouls with two bookings (Ganiou, Sotoca), forced to foul to stop play
16938941.headline_en: Leipzig have it in hand and may slow the tempo; Lens corners will rise as they push, but their threat is limited.
16938941.changes_en: Home win up from 70% to 95.5%; most likely score now 2-0; Lens fouls (10.0 → 14.5) and cards (2.0 → 3.2) raised sharply; Leipzig fouls lowered.

16938972.verdict: 第2分鐘的烏龍球讓 Porto 領先，但場面和 xG 其實均勢，和預測的拉鋸走勢相近。
points: Targhalline 第2分鐘烏龍球是運氣成分，雙方 xG 都是 0.71，半場比分偏離預測的 0-0 主要是因為這個意外
Porto 上半場已經兩張黃牌（Froholdt、A. Costa），超過預測的 0.7 張，Feyenoord 沒有黃牌
Feyenoord 角球 3 比 1、控球 55%，主隊進攻比預期積極
16938972.headline: Feyenoord 會加強進攻追平，Porto 兩名吃黃牌的球員要收斂，防守反擊為主。
16938972.changes: 客勝從 44% 升到 65%，因為已經領先；Porto 全場黃牌從 2.2 升到 3.0；Feyenoord 落後壓上，角球由 4.7 升到 6.5，Porto 角球降到 3.0。
16938972.verdict_en: A 2nd-minute own goal put Porto ahead, but the play and xG were level, close to the forecast tight contest.
points_en: Targhalline's 2' own goal was luck; both sides had 0.71 xG, so the gap from the predicted 0-0 HT is down to that accident
Porto already have two bookings (Froholdt, A. Costa), above the 0.7 forecast; Feyenoord none
Feyenoord led corners 3-1 with 55% possession, more attacking than expected
16938972.headline_en: Feyenoord will push for an equaliser; Porto's two booked players must be careful, so expect Porto to defend and counter.
16938972.changes_en: Away win up from 44% to 65% on the lead; Porto full-time cards 2.2 → 3.0; Feyenoord corners 4.7 → 6.5 as they chase, Porto down to 3.0.

16938980.verdict: Aston Villa 上半場稍佔優勢，Galatasaray 幾乎沒有進攻，比賽節奏碎、犯規多，0-0 和預測相符。
points: 半場 0-0 符合賽前預測；上半場進球預測 [0.5, 0.7]，實際 xG 0.02-0.53，Aston Villa 有一次絕佳機會，Galatasaray 少了 Osimhen，進攻幾乎沒有威脅。
角球 1-1，低於預測的 [2.0, 2.6]；犯規 9-8，明顯高於預測 [5.5, 5.3]，比賽經常被打斷。
黃牌 0-1（41' N. Jackson），裁判 Siebert 暫時比預期克制，但犯規多，下半場出牌可能增加。
16938980.headline: 下半場 Aston Villa 仍是較可能進球的一方，Galatasaray 需要靠主場氣氛和定位球；一球決勝或平局的機會很大。
16938980.changes: 客勝由 46% 降到 41%，主勝由 29% 降到 22%，平局由 25% 升到 37%：上半場沒有進球、剩下的時間不多，加上 Galatasaray 進攻乏力。最可能比分由 1-2 改為 0-1；全場犯規因上半場節奏大幅上調，角球略為下調。N. Jackson 已有黃牌，之後會收斂一些。
16938980.verdict_en: Aston Villa edged a scrappy first half while Galatasaray offered almost nothing in attack; 0-0 as predicted.
points_en: HT 0-0 matched the prediction; 1H goals predicted [0.5, 0.7], actual xG 0.02-0.53 – Villa had one big chance, Galatasaray without Osimhen were toothless.
Corners 1-1, below the predicted [2.0, 2.6]; fouls 9-8, well above the predicted [5.5, 5.3], with constant stoppages.
Cards 0-1 (41' N. Jackson); Siebert more restrained so far, but the foul count suggests more cards after the break.
16938980.headline_en: Villa remain the likelier scorers in the second half; Galatasaray need the crowd and set pieces. A one-goal game or a draw is very likely.
16938980.changes_en: Away win cut from 46% to 41% and home win from 29% to 22%, draw raised from 25% to 37%: no goals, less time left, and a weak Galatasaray attack. Most likely score changed from 1-2 to 0-1; full-time fouls raised sharply because of the first-half tempo, corners trimmed slightly. N. Jackson is on a yellow and should be more careful.

16939011.verdict: 半場 0-0 猜對了，但比賽遠比預期激烈：角球 7-0 一邊倒，黃牌已有 4 張，上半場最後 Villarreal 還被 VAR 改判紅牌，下半場只剩 10 人。
points: 半場比分 0-0 準確。上半進球預測 0.6/0.7，實際 0-0，雙方 xG 合計只有 0.2，進攻質量都很低，比賽偏沉悶、偏膠著。
角球是最大的誤差：預測 2.6/2.1，實際 7-0。Slavia Praha 控球雖少（44%），卻不斷從邊路傳中和打定位球，Villarreal 一直被逼解圍。
犯規 8/7 略高於預測的 6.2/5.8；黃牌已有 2/2，遠超預測的 0.5/0.9。45 分鐘 R. Veiga 先吃黃牌，再經 VAR 改判紅牌，Villarreal 下半場要以 10 人應戰。
16939011.headline: 多一人的 Slavia Praha 會在主場持續圍攻，角球和傳中更多。Villarreal 會退守打反擊，比賽很可能是 1 球定勝負，甚至 0-0。
16939011.changes: 賽前看好 Villarreal（客勝 43%），現在因紅牌改為略看好 Slavia Praha（主勝 44%），平局升到 42%。比分由 1-1／1-2 改為 0-0／1-0，因為上半場 xG 極低，Villarreal 少一人後攻擊力大減。全場角球大幅提高 Slavia Praha 一方（11.0 對 1.5）。黃牌由賽前 1.6/2.3 上調到 2.5/3.0，犯規也上調，Villarreal 以 10 人防守會犯規更多。
16939011.verdict_en: The 0-0 half-time call was right, but the game was far more heated than expected: corners 7-0, four yellows already, and a VAR red card for Villarreal just before the break, so they play the second half with 10 men.
points_en: Half-time 0-0 was correct. First-half goals were forecast at 0.6/0.7; it finished 0-0 with combined xG of only 0.2, so both attacks were poor and the game was tight and scrappy.
Corners were the big miss: forecast 2.6/2.1, actual 7-0. Despite only 44% possession, Slavia Praha kept crossing and winning set pieces, forcing Villarreal into constant clearances.

Fouls at 8/7 were a little above the 6.2/5.8 forecast; yellows at 2/2 were far above the 0.5/0.9 forecast. R. Veiga was booked in the 45th minute and then shown a red card after VAR review, so Villarreal are down to 10 men.
16939011.headline_en: With the extra man, Slavia Praha should lay siege at home with even more corners and crosses, while Villarreal sit deep and counter. Most likely a one-goal game, or even 0-0.
16939011.changes_en: Before kick-off we favoured Villarreal (43% away win). After the red card we now slightly favour Slavia Praha (44% home win), with the draw up to 42%. Likely scores move from 1-1/1-2 to 0-0/1-0, because first-half xG was very low and Villarreal's attack is badly weakened with 10 men. Full-time corners are raised sharply for Slavia Praha (11.0 vs 1.5). Yellow cards go up from 1.6/2.3 to 2.5/3.0, and fouls rise too, since a 10-man Villarreal will have to foul more to defend.

16939014.verdict: 跟賽前預期一樣，Barcelona 75% 控球、壓著打，憑 A. Gordon 一球領先，半場 0-1 完全猜中。
points: 半場比分 0-1 準確；上半進球 0.2/1.2 和實際 0/1 很接近。Barcelona 射門 11-3、射正 5-1、xG 0.99，Sabah 門將撲救 4 次，避免了更大比分。
角球 1/2 略低於預測的 1.5/3.4。Barcelona 多在禁區前沿用短傳配合進攻，較少靠傳中贏得角球。
犯規只有 3/4、黃牌 0/0，比預測的 5.0/5.2、0.8/0.6 都低，比賽節奏平和，Sabah 選擇退守而不是逼搶。
16939014.headline: 下半場 Barcelona 應該會繼續控制比賽並擴大比分。Sabah 需要壓上時，可能會被打反擊，自己也有機會打進挽回面子的一球。
16939014.changes: 客勝由 87% 微升到 90%，因為已經領先、上半場數據完全壓制。最可能比分由 0-3 改為 0-2，Barcelona 的進球效率比預期低。全場角球（3.0/6.8 → 2.3/5.5）、犯規（11.5/11.5 → 8.5/9.0）和黃牌（2.0/1.5 → 1.1/0.7）都下調，因為上半場節奏平和、身體對抗少。
16939014.verdict_en: Exactly as expected: Barcelona controlled 75% of the ball and lead 0-1 through A. Gordon, so the half-time score was called perfectly.
points_en: Half-time 0-1 was correct, and first-half goals at 0.2/1.2 were close to the actual 0/1. Barcelona had 11 shots to 3, 5 on target to 1 and 0.99 xG; four saves from Sabah's keeper kept the score down.
Corners at 1/2 came in slightly below the 1.5/3.4 forecast. Barcelona mostly worked short passing moves around the box rather than winning corners from crosses.
Fouls (3/4) and yellows (0/0) were both below the forecast of 5.0/5.2 and 0.8/0.6. The game was calm, with Sabah sitting deep rather than pressing.
16939014.headline_en: Barcelona should keep control and add to their lead in the second half. If Sabah push forward they risk being caught on the counter, though they may also find a consolation goal.
16939014.changes_en: Away win nudged up from 87% to 90%, since Barcelona already lead and dominated every first-half stat. Most likely score changes from 0-3 to 0-2, because Barcelona's finishing has been less efficient than expected. Full-time corners (3.0/6.8 → 2.3/5.5), fouls (11.5/11.5 → 8.5/9.0) and yellows (2.0/1.5 → 1.1/0.7) are all cut, since the first half was calm with little physical contact.

16939035.verdict: Como 控球和 xG 都佔優，但臨門一腳不準，半場 0-0，沒有達到預測的 1-0。
points: Como xG 1.27，射門 9 次只有 1 次射正，是終結問題，不是機會不夠；缺少 Kean 的影響很明顯
AEK 射正 3 次反而比 Como 多，門將 Como 方面撲救 3 次，AEK 反擊有一定威脅
雙方角球各只有 1 個，遠低於預測；犯規 7 比 9 高於預測，比賽節奏零碎，N. Paz 早早吃到黃牌
16939035.headline: Como 下半場會繼續圍攻，但終結力不足，小比分贏球或平局的可能性大。
16939035.changes: 主勝從 74% 大幅降到 56%，平局升到 31%；最可能比分由 2-0 改成 1-0；角球大幅下調（5.2/3.6 → 4.5/2.8），犯規上調。
16939035.verdict_en: Como dominated possession and xG but finishing let them down; 0-0 at HT instead of the predicted 1-0.
points_en: Como had 1.27 xG but only 1 of 9 shots on target, a finishing problem, not a lack of chances; Kean's absence shows
AEK had more shots on target (3) and forced 3 saves, their counters carry some threat
Only 1 corner each, far below forecast; fouls 7-9 above forecast in a stop-start game, N. Paz booked early
16939035.headline_en: Como will keep pressing in the second half, but poor finishing points to a narrow win or a draw.
16939035.changes_en: Home win cut from 74% to 56%, draw up to 31%; most likely score 2-0 → 1-0; corners cut sharply (5.2/3.6 → 4.5/2.8), fouls raised.

16939039.verdict: 半場比分 0-1 猜中，Real Betis 機會品質明顯較高（xG 0.89 對 0.28），但壓制力不如預期，角球只有 1 比 1。
points: 半場比分和上半場進球（預測 0.3 比 1.05，實際 0 比 1）基本準確；C. Hernández 第 43 分鐘破門，Real Betis 4 腳射正，Slovan 只有 2 腳。
上半場角球預測 1.2 比 3.2，實際 1 比 1，明顯高估了 Real Betis。客隊控球 58% 但沒有持續圍攻，Slovan 還有 7 次射門和 3 次越位，說明他們不是一味死守。
上半場犯規 4 比 5，接近預測的 5.0 比 5.4；黃牌 1 比 1，略高於預測的 0.7 比 0.7，F. Bernal 和 R. Ibrahim 下半場都要收斂。
16939039.headline: Slovan 落後只能壓上，Real Betis 有很多反擊空間，最可能是守住 0-1 或擴大比分。
16939039.changes: 客勝機率從 74% 升到 81%，因為已領先而且 xG 佔優；最可能比分由 0-2 改成 0-1，因為只剩下半場，再進兩球的機率不高；全場角球由 2.6 比 6.8 調整為 3.0 比 4.0，因為上半場 Real Betis 沒有角球壓制，Slovan 落後後會壓上爭取角球；犯規和黃牌大致維持不變。
16939039.verdict_en: The 0-1 half-time call was right. Real Betis created the better chances (xG 0.89 vs 0.28) but dominated less than expected, with corners level at 1-1.
points_en: The half-time score and first-half goals (0.3 vs 1.05 predicted, 0-1 actual) were broadly accurate. C. Hernández scored in the 43rd minute; Real Betis had 4 shots on target to Slovan's 2.

First-half corners were predicted 1.2 vs 3.2 but finished 1-1, so Real Betis were clearly overrated here. With 58% possession they never kept up sustained pressure, and Slovan's 7 shots and 3 offsides show they were not just sitting deep.
First-half fouls were 4 vs 5, close to the 5.0 vs 5.4 forecast. Cards were 1-1, slightly above the 0.7 each predicted; F. Bernal and R. Ibrahim will have to be careful in the second half.
16939039.headline_en: Slovan must push forward while behind, leaving Real Betis lots of room to counter. Most likely outcome: Betis hold 0-1 or extend the lead.
16939039.changes_en: Away win up from 74% to 81% because Betis lead and have the better xG. Most likely score changed from 0-2 to 0-1, since two more goals in one half is unlikely. Full-time corners moved from 2.6 vs 6.8 to 3.0 vs 4.0: Betis had no corner dominance in the first half, and Slovan will chase corners while behind. Fouls and cards are roughly unchanged.
